title: Step 1a - Python K-Means Tutorial: Identifying Customer Patterns in Mall Data

cues.en: Instructor: Hello, my friends, and welcome to the practical activity of this new part, Part 4, Clustering, where we're gonna build two clustering models,
cues.zh: 講師：朋友們，大家好，歡迎來到第四部分「分群」的實作活動。我們將建立兩種分群模型，

cues.en: K-means and hierarchical clustering.
cues.zh: K-means 與階層式分群。

cues.en: And of course, we're gonna start with K-means, which is actually the most popular model in clustering.
cues.zh: 當然，我們先從 K-means 開始，它其實是分群中最受歡迎的模型。

cues.en: And indeed, we will see together that it provides fantastic results.
cues.zh: 我們也會一起看到，它能產生非常棒的結果。

cues.en: So you just saw the intuition lectures with CuRel, and now we're gonna put that theory into practice by building this K-means clustering model
cues.zh: 你剛看完 Kirill 的直覺概念課，現在我們要把理論付諸實踐，建立 K-means 分群模型，

cues.en: in both Python and R.
cues.zh: 分別用 Python 和 R 實作。

cues.en: And now we should all be on the same page, and therefore we're gonna go to this folder here, Part 4, Clustering, and then we'll attack K-means clustering.
cues.zh: 現在大家的進度應該一致，所以進入這個第四部分「分群」資料夾，再來處理 K-means 分群。

cues.en: And we're gonna start with Python, of course.
cues.zh: 當然先從 Python 開始。

cues.en: And this is your folder containing two files.
cues.zh: 這個資料夾裡有兩個檔案。

cues.en: First, the K-means clustering implementation in the IPYNB format, which therefore you can open with either Google Colaboratory or Jupyter Notebook.
cues.zh: 第一個是 IPYNB 格式的 K-means 分群實作，因此可以用 Google Colaboratory 或 Jupyter Notebook 開啟。

cues.en: And then you have Mall Customers.csv which is the CSV file, the data set with which we will work in this section to build our K-means clustering model.
cues.zh: 另外是 Mall_Customers.csv，這個 CSV 資料集就是本單元建立 K-means 分群模型時要用的資料。

cues.en: All right, so first step, as usual, I will explain what this data set is about, which will allow me to explain the purpose of this mission, the why we want to build the K-means algorithm,
cues.zh: 好，第一步照慣例先說明資料集內容，藉此解釋這次任務的目的，也就是為什麼要建立 K-means 演算法，

cues.en: and what for.
cues.zh: 以及它的用途。

cues.en: And then we'll start, of course, our implementation from scratch, step by step.
cues.zh: 接著當然會從零開始，一步一步實作。

cues.en: And you'll take action with me to build the K-means algorithm.
cues.zh: 你會和我一起動手建立 K-means 演算法。

cues.en: All right?
cues.zh: 好嗎？

cues.en: So what is this data set about?
cues.zh: 這個資料集在講什麼呢？

cues.en: Well, as you can see by the title of this data set, Mall Customers, well, it's actually a data set made by a mall, the strategic team, let's say,
cues.zh: 從標題 Mall Customers 可以看出，這其實是購物中心製作的資料集；假設是購物中心的策略團隊，

cues.en: of the mall that collected some data about their customers.
cues.zh: 蒐集了顧客的一些資料。

cues.en: So here, it's important to see it this way.
cues.zh: 這裡要用這個角度理解。

cues.en: Each row corresponds to a customer of the mall.
cues.zh: 每一列都對應購物中心的一位顧客。

cues.en: And for each of these customers of the mall, well, the data analyst of this team gathered the following information, first, the customer ID, then the genre, male, female,
cues.zh: 對於每位顧客，團隊的資料分析師蒐集了以下資訊：首先是顧客 ID，接著是性別，男性或女性，

cues.en: then the age, the annual income.
cues.zh: 然後是年齡與年收入。

cues.en: And let's expand this...
cues.zh: 我們把這裡展開……

cues.en: Well, I can't do it here, but that last variable is the spending score, and it can take values between 1 and 100.
cues.zh: 這裡沒辦法展開，不過最後一個變數是消費分數，數值介於 1 到 100。

cues.en: So all these features are pretty clear.
cues.zh: 這些特徵都相當清楚。

cues.en: Let me explain what this one means.
cues.zh: 讓我說明這個特徵的意思。

cues.en: The spending score is a metric made by the mall to measure, how much each customer spends.
cues.zh: 消費分數是購物中心建立的指標，用來衡量每位顧客的消費金額。

cues.en: And so they made this metric, which takes values from 1 to a 100, that's the scale of the metric, such that, well, the lower the score, the less the customer spends,
cues.zh: 這個指標的尺度從 1 到 100，分數越低，代表顧客花得越少，

cues.en: and the higher the score, the more the customer spends in a certain period of time, let's say, in the past year.
cues.zh: 分數越高，代表顧客在特定期間花得越多，例如過去一年。

cues.en: Okay?
cues.zh: 好嗎？

cues.en: So for example, this customer actually spends a lot in this mall, because he has a score of 81.
cues.zh: 例如這位顧客在購物中心花得很多，因為他的分數是 81。

cues.en: However, this customer spends very few in the mall, because she has a score of six.
cues.zh: 相對地，這位顧客在購物中心花得很少，因為她的分數是 6。

cues.en: All right?
cues.zh: 好嗎？

cues.en: So that's just a metric measuring the spending of each customer.
cues.zh: 所以這只是衡量每位顧客消費情況的指標。

cues.en: And so now, what is the purpose of this mission?
cues.zh: 那麼，這次任務的目的是什麼？

cues.en: What did this strategic team or analytics team want to do?
cues.zh: 這個策略團隊或分析團隊想做什麼？

cues.en: Well, as you might guess, since right now we're doing clustering, this team wants to very simply understand it's customers.
cues.zh: 既然現在正在做分群，你可能也猜到了，這個團隊只是想了解自己的顧客。

cues.en: They want to identify some patterns within it's customers, within it's base of customers.
cues.zh: 他們想找出顧客群中的一些模式。

cues.en: And that's the key thing to understand here when doing clustering.
cues.zh: 這就是進行分群時要掌握的關鍵。

cues.en: This time as opposed to, previously with regression and classification, where we were actually knowing what to predict, well, this time we actually have no idea what to predict.
cues.zh: 先前做迴歸與分類時，我們知道要預測什麼；這次不同，我們其實不知道要預測什麼。

cues.en: But even though we don't know what specifically to predict, we still know that we want to identify some patterns.
cues.zh: 但即使不知道具體要預測什麼，仍然知道我們想辨識某些模式。

cues.en: And that's the why of this mission, the purpose of this mission.
cues.zh: 這就是這次任務的原因與目的。

cues.en: Okay?
cues.zh: 好嗎？

cues.en: So it's good, we understand the why, and now let's understand the how.
cues.zh: 很好，我們了解為什麼要做了，接著來了解怎麼做。

cues.en: How are we going to identify such patterns?
cues.zh: 要怎麼找出這些模式呢？

cues.en: Well, we will do this with K-means, of course.
cues.zh: 當然是使用 K-means。

cues.en: And more specifically, what we will do is we will create a dependent variable.
cues.zh: 更具體地說，我們會建立一個應變數。

cues.en: Right?
cues.zh: 對吧？

cues.en: We'll create a dependent variable, which will take a finite number of values, let's say four or five values.
cues.zh: 我們會建立一個應變數，它的可能值只有有限個，例如四個或五個。

cues.en: And actually each of the values will be a class of this dependent variable we're going to create.
cues.zh: 每個值其實就是這個新建立應變數的一種類別。

cues.en: And that's exactly what clustering means, technically in the details.
cues.zh: 從技術細節來看，這正是分群的意思。

cues.en: If you wanna be broad on how to explain clustering, you would say that we are identifying some patterns in the data.
cues.zh: 如果要概括說明分群，可以說我們在辨識資料中的模式。

cues.en: But if you want to clearly explain how to identify these patterns in the data, well, you would say that we are building a dependent variable, we are creating it in such a way that each
cues.zh: 但如果要明確解釋如何找出這些模式，就可以說我們正在建立一個應變數，而且建立的方式會讓

cues.en: of the values of this future dependent variable we are creating are actually the classes of this dependent variable.
cues.zh: 這個未來應變數的每個值，實際上代表該應變數的一種類別。

cues.en: All right?
cues.zh: 好嗎？

cues.en: So this will become much more clear once we build our K-means algorithm, and we get that dependent variable we are creating.
cues.zh: 等到建立 K-means 演算法，取得這個新建立的應變數後，這個概念就會清楚得多。

cues.en: But please remember this, we are creating a dependent variable.
cues.zh: 但請記住，我們正在建立一個應變數。
